title: MYOS
summary: MYOS is a small, from-scratch x86 operating system kernel in C and assembly, built for educational purposes to teach bootloaders, protected mode, and basic drivers. A stray requirements.txt for an unrelated 'synthflow-ai' subproject inside the repo lists sdv and ctgan as dependencies, but no code in the evidence imports or calls them.
evidence: synthflow-ai/requirements.txt: sdv>=0.17.0; ctgan>=0.5.0 -- no call sites found
needs: Only a dependency declaration in an apparently unrelated subfolder (synthflow-ai) exists; no code evidence shows sdv/ctgan actually invoked, and the relationship of that subproject to the OS-kernel repo is unclear.
